PAIN MANAGEMENT IN THE ED  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PARACETAMOL 
Adults  
•
1g PO 
•
1g IV over 30 minutes 
•
TTO: 1g PO q6-8hrly 
 
Paeds  
•
15-20mg/kg PO q8hrly  
•
Weight x 0.6 = ml of syrup [120mg/5ml] 
 
 
Caution: liver impairment 
NON-STEROIDAL ANTI-INFLAMMATORIES (NSAIDs) 
 
 
IBUPROFEN 
Adults  
•
200 – 600 mg PO 
•
TTO: 200 – 400mg PO q6-8hrly cc (with meals) 
 
Paeds  
•
5-10mg/kg/dose PO q6-8hrly cc   (NB! not to exceed 40mg/kg/day) 
 
 
Caution: renal failure, bleeding / PUD, elderly 
OPIOIDS 
 
FENTANYL   
•
1µg/kg IV slowly     (Duration of action: 30-45min) 
•
1-2µg/kg/hr infusion 
•
Cardio stable 
 
MORPHINE 
•
0.1mg/kg IV     (Duration of action: 4-6hrs) 
•
0.1mg/kg/hr infusion 
 
TRAMADOL 
•
1mg/kg IV/PO 
•
TTO: 50-100mg po q8hrly 
KETAMINE 
IV 
•
0.3-1mg/kg (slow IV over 5-10min) 
•
0.2-1mg/kg/hr infusion (see Ketamine infusion protocol) 
Paeds 
•
2-6mg/kg IM 
•
6-10mg/kg PO (mix with 0.2-0.3ml/kg of beverage, 30min prior to procedure) 
Intranasal 
•
1mg/kg IN (max 0.5ml/nostril) 
Dr R Gihwala CMJAH Emergency Department June 2020
